intro: Cheviot Hills is a quiet, green neighborhood of winding streets between Century City and Culver City, anchored by its big recreation center and the Rancho Park golf course, with neighborhood restaurants along Pico Boulevard nearby.

gm: Google Maps reviews (local favorites we checked)
